title: Duck River
description: The first version is loosely based on the playing of Sheesham and Lotus.
versionDescriptions: The second version is based on the playing of Art Stamper, with some chord variations.
chordVersionDescriptions: The first version will fit most situations. The second version occasionally substitutes a Bm for the D, plus it has an E chord in the second section in case the melody plays a G# instead of G natural.
